title: OpenAI's AI smart speaker will reportedly be shaped 'like a doughnut'
excerpt: The portable device will use a camera system and microphones to learn about its user.
content_html:
OpenAI's screenless smart speaker will reportedly be shaped "like a doughnut" and carry a price tag in the ballpark of $300. Bloomberg revealed new details about OpenAI's upcoming hardware device on Tuesday, citing sources familiar with the matter.

According to Bloomberg's report, OpenAI's AI-powered smart speaker will have a doughnut-like form factor and be comparable in size to a hockey puck, a design apparently intended to make it easily portable in one hand. This is in line with a previous report from The Wall Street Journal that users would be able to carry the device in their pocket.

The speaker will reportedly have a metal design as well, giving it a "premium look." Last May, OpenAI announced that it had acquired iPhone designer Jony Ive's startup io, signalling that the AI company was moving into hardware. Now Bloomberg reports that OpenAI's smart speaker will "use upscale materials like high-quality metal," likely hoping to emulate the success of Apple's distinct product design.

You May Also Like

OpenAI has not officially announced its smart speaker yet, much less revealed a price tag. However, Bloomberg's sources state that the company is looking at placing it around the $300 to $400 mark.

Mashable Light Speed

A previous Bloomberg report last month revealed that OpenAI's smart speaker will have moving mechanical parts which respond to users, aimed at making the device seem more lifelike and personable. It will also actively monitor users and learn about them, using microphones, a camera system, and other sensors, as well as through methods such as accessing their emails. A light will indicate when the device is listening to its environment.

Data gathered by the speaker will then be fed to its AI algorithm, ostensibly so that it can give users more personalised service and offer assistance without prompting. Bloomberg reports that the smart speaker will essentially operate as a more advanced version of voice mode in OpenAI's ChatGPT app.

Last year, the Journal reported that OpenAI hopes to ship 100 million of these devices, with the aim of making them as ubiquitous as smartphones.

Disclosure: Ziff Davis, Mashable’s parent company, in April 2025 filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging it infringed Ziff Davis copyrights in training and operating its AI systems.

content_html_zh:
据报道，OpenAI 的无屏智能扬声器形状将“像甜甜圈”，价格约为 300 美元。 彭博社周二援引知情人士的话透露了有关 OpenAI 即将推出的硬件设备的新细节。

据彭博社报道，OpenAI 的人工智能智能扬声器将具有类似甜甜圈的外形，大小与冰球相当，这种设计显然是为了使其可以轻松单手携带。 这与《华尔街日报》之前的报道一致，即用户可以将该设备放在口袋里携带。

据报道，该扬声器也将采用金属设计，赋予其“高级外观”。 去年5月，OpenAI宣布收购iPhone设计师Jony Ive的初创公司io，标志着这家AI公司正在进军硬件领域。 现在，彭博社报道称，OpenAI 的智能扬声器将“使用优质金属等高档材料”，可能希望效仿苹果独特产品设计的成功。

你可能也喜欢

OpenAI 尚未正式宣布其智能音箱，更不用说公布价格标签了。 然而，彭博社的消息人士称，该公司正在考虑将其价格定在 300 至 400 美元左右。

可混搭光速

彭博社上个月的一份报告显示，OpenAI 的智能扬声器将拥有可响应用户的移动机械部件，旨在使该设备看起来更加逼真和风度翩翩。 它还将使用麦克风、摄像头系统和其他传感器以及通过访问用户的电子邮件等方法来主动监控用户并了解他们。 当设备正在监听其环境时，指示灯将会亮起。

然后，扬声器收集的数据将被输入其人工智能算法，表面上是为了给用户提供更加个性化的服务，并在没有提示的情况下提供帮助。 彭博社报道称，这款智能音箱本质上将作为 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 应用程序中语音模式的更高级版本运行。

去年，《华尔街日报》报道称，OpenAI 希望出货 1 亿台此类设备，目标是让它们像智能手机一样无处不在。

披露：Mashable 的母公司 Ziff Davis 于 2025 年 4 月对 OpenAI 提起诉讼，指控其在训练和运营其人工智能系统时侵犯了 Ziff Davis 的版​​权。
